comment: nodemon watches this whole directory by default, which restarts the dev
server whenever anything here is written - including files a running
script writes itself. That bit twice: scripts/importInvListSm.mjs writes
a backup under backups/ before it starts, and the restart dropped the
connection mid-import (ECONNRESET on the next request).
So: watch only the source the server actually runs. scripts/ is left out
on purpose too - those are one-off and regression scripts, run by hand
against the running server, and editing one has never been a reason to
